_comment: UN M49 subregion names. Source: unstats.un.org/unsd/methodology/m49/. The list is closed: 17 subregions cover every country and territory that M49 assigns one. Caribbean, Central America, South America and the African regions below Sub-Saharan Africa are intermediate regions, kept in m49_intermediate_region_snapshot.json.

meta.closed_reason: A static copy of UN M49's 17 subregions (see _comment). It has no review date: it is updated by hand when UN M49 changes a subregion, an event, not a date. tools/check_snapshot_freshness.py skips it.
